verdict.rationale: Consensus lets users import their own paper collections from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF or RIS into an "AI-powered workspace" where they can search, "find gaps" and put the collection to work. Across the broader corpus it also offers AI synthesis, Consensus Meter verdicts and PICO extraction, with citations attached to each insight. Missing for 10: specifics on what AI insights or suggestions are generated from the user's own library (beyond the brief "find gaps" claim), documentation of proactive suggestions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
